summary: Backend-only testing for Otter Flow Auth + Project CRUD. Ran both pytest suites: (1) tests/test_crud.py — CRUD + ownership isolation via FastAPI dependency-override against real Supabase Postgres, and (2) tests/test_live_e2e.py — LIVE end-to-end against deployed API using real Clerk session JWTs minted via Clerk Backend API for two ephemeral users. All 7 requested behaviors verified: 401 on unauth/invalid token, 201 on create, list/read, update, 204 on delete + 404 after, cross-user isolation returns 404 for GET/PUT/DELETE, and DB-level persistence check. Both tests PASSED (2/2) in 19.2s.

minor.issue: Pydantic v2 deprecation: class-based `Config` in ProjectOut; should use ConfigDict. Non-blocking.

action_items: Optional: replace class-based Config with ConfigDict in ProjectOut (server.py) to silence Pydantic v2 deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py commits the user upsert on every request via `db.commit()` inside get_current_user — fine functionally, but this adds a write round-trip per authenticated call; consider caching or upserting only on first sight per session.

server.py update_project: `payload.description.strip() or None` means an empty string clears description, but there is no way to distinguish 'not provided' vs 'explicit null' beyond None; acceptable given current schema.
No pagination on GET /api/projects — fine for MVP, flag for later.
Route ordering is safe (static /me before /projects/{id}). No _id / ObjectId concerns (Postgres, not Mongo). Owner-scoping is enforced consistently in _get_owned_project.
test_credentials: Clerk ephemeral users minted per-test via CLERK_SECRET_KEY (/app/backend/.env); no static creds needed.
seed_data_creation: None persisted; both suites create and clean up their own users/projects.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend Auth + Project CRUD is fully green against live Supabase + real Clerk JWTs. Run `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v` to reproduce. Session/Capsule endpoints do not exist yet — do not test until implemented. Frontend was not tested (backend-only request).
